description: This file contains unit tests for the MediaPipeline component, specifically testing the data handling and event notification mechanisms within the Rialto client media pipeline. It includes mock setups, test scenarios for needData, haveData, and segment addition, as well as handling of different playback states and application states.

classes.name: RialtoClientMediaPipelineDataTest
classes.description: Test fixture class for testing the Rialto client media pipeline's data handling and event notification logic.

methods.name: SetUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, creates media pipeline, sets up shared memory info, attaches source, and sets default playback state.

methods.name: TearDown
methods.description: Cleans up the test environment, deletes frames, destroys media pipeline, and resets mocks.

methods.name: attachSource
methods.description: Attaches a media source with a given source ID to the media pipeline.

methods.name: needDataGeneric
methods.description: Triggers a generic needData event with current source ID, frame count, request ID, and shared memory info.

methods.name: addFrames
methods.description: Adds a specified number of frames of a given media source type with provided data to the pipeline.

methods.name: deleteFrames
methods.description: Deletes all stored frames from the internal vector.

methods.name: haveDataSuccess
methods.description: Simulates a successful haveData call, expecting the mock to return true.

methods.name: createFrame
methods.description: Creates a media segment frame of specified type, data, and timestamp.

methods.name: startAddSegmentThread
methods.description: Starts a thread that simulates adding a segment and waiting for buffer processing.
